title: Rusted Porthole Vision
description: A circular, heavily corroded metal porthole covered in barnacles, seashells, and white encrustations frames a surreal landscape. Inside the porthole view, three illuminated train cars sit on a purple plain under an aurora sky, with human silhouettes standing inside, while a spiral staircase rises in the distance.
prompt: A large circular corroded metal porthole covered in barnacles, seashells, and dripping white crustaceans frames a surreal dreamlike scene. Inside the round window are three illuminated train cars standing on a vast purple plain, with human silhouettes visible inside, a glowing aurora borealis in the teal and orange sky, and a twisting spiral staircase floating in the distance, surreal painting style.
